title: Gulfside Hideaway
meta_description: Find the perfect 30A, FL vacation rental at “Gulfside Hideaway”, a luxury 6-bed, 6.5-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 18 guests, this home offers a Private Pool, Pool House & Golf Cart for your exclusive enjoyment. Book your memorable stay now!
description_expanded: Home Highlights -Private Resort Style Pool and Spa (Pool can be heated for an additional $70 per day from October 1 - May 1) -Pool House Game Room with Additional Sleeping -6 Seater Golf Cart Included -6 Bikes Included Set on a generous, private lot in the coveted Eastern Lake area, this exceptional new-construction beach retreat offers refined coastal living near the Gulf. Located south of 30A, the home delivers both privacy and effortless access to one of the area’s most desirable stretches of beach. Designed with entertaining in mind, the open-concept interiors flow seamlessly to an elegant outdoor oasis featuring a private resort-style pool and spa with a wet deck, an ideal setting for sun-soaked afternoons or evening relaxation. (Pool heat available for an additional $70 per day from October 1–May 1.) A stylish pool house with a game room and additional sleeping accommodations enhances the resort-like experience, while the main residence showcases upscale finishes throughout. The primary suite serves as a private sanctuary with a spa-inspired bath, soaking tub, separate shower, and a custom-designed closet. With a six-seater golf cart and six bikes included, exploring 30A and nearby favorites is effortless. Perfect for families or discerning groups, this Eastern Lake home offers a polished blend of luxury, comfort, and coastal sophistication. Sleeping Arrangements First Floor - King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only - 1/2 Bathroom Second Floor - Queen Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only - Queen Bedroom w/ Shared Bathroom, Shower Only - Master King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower/Tub Separate Pool House - Two Queen over Queen Bunks, Private Bathroom, Shower Only Carriage House - Queen over Queen Bunk - Queen Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only *Property has nearby construction*
